title: A page loader must let a second caller wait for a page already in flight
rule: When a store fetches list pages on demand and remembers which pages are pending, keep the pending promise (Map<page, Promise>) and have every caller await it; do not skip a pending page and return early. A caller that awaits ensure() and then reads the item (keyboard End, jump to selection) must find it. Test it with a mock whose listGlyphs/listFamilies answer is held by a gate or a delay: start two ensure() calls for the same page and assert the second resolves only after the answer and the item is there.
rationale: E42.5 (#456): ensure() skipped in-flight pages, so End on a list longer than one page moved the cursor but never selected the glyph; tests passed because the mock answered at once.
